instruction.text: Listen to what Danielle is saying and decide what you could do to be a good listener.

atoms.a: There’s something I’ve been thinking about for a few days.
I want to join the school newspaper, but I’m not sure.
I love writing and doing research.
It’s just that I already have so many hobbies. I’m afraid it might be too much.
What do you think I should do?

feedback.end: Active listening is more than just hearing the words. It means really paying attention to the person who is talking.

instruction.text: Are these techniques part of active listening?

atoms.a: focusing on what the speaker is saying
asking clarifying questions if something isn’t clear to you
interrupting the speaker to talk about yourself
turning your body away from the speaker
